entities.name: Margareta Cederschiöld
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Margareta Cordelia Cederschiöld was a Swedish tennis player who competed in the 1912 Summer Olympics. She was eliminated in the quarter-finals of the outdoor singles. She lost in the first round in the indoor singles. In the indoor mixed doubles, she and her partner Carl Kempe finished fourth without competing in the bronze medal match.

entities.summary: Margareta Cordelia Cederschiöld was a Swedish tennis player who competed in the 1912 Summer Olympics. She was eliminated in the quarter-finals of the outdoor singles. She lost in the first round in the indoor singles. In the indoor mixed doubles, she and her partner Carl Kempe finished fourth without competing in the bronze medal match.
